mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.2% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return discount as investors anticipate rate hikes, leading to negative 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.2% in a given month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressure, which precedes a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as profit expectations fall.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% in a month
failure_condition: Over 12 months, no significant negative returns in months with PAYEMS > 0.5% increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding two consecutive drops predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a rebound in economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 shows two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: Over 100 such events, 5-day forward returns are not positive (mean <= 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index below 90 triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as low supply growth prompts optimism about future demand.
failure_condition: In 50 such events, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits a positive 60-day forward return as higher policy rates are expected to slow inflation.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS stays above 5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 30 such periods, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment below 4.5% triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a tightening labor market and higher inflation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in a month
failure_condition: Over 40 such events, 20-day returns are not negative (mean >= 0, p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in HOUST housing starts and RSAFS retail sales above 2% each predict a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as dual demand signals strengthen.
candidate_trigger: Both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% in the same month
failure_condition: Over 100 such events, 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to post-crisis supply expansion (INDPRO > 105 for 3 months) is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates sustained output growth.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO remains above 105 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: In 20 such regimes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
